name: Zoho ZeptoMail
summary: Sends the platform's email through Zoho ZeptoMail (Zoho CPaaS), and records its bounces and complaints.

capabilities.trigger_rule: A message the outbox holds for sending: one a person or a rule of the platform asked for.

url.title: Email endpoint
url.description: The account's email endpoint, as Zoho's API page names it.

dns_records.title: DNS records
dns_records.description: The records each sending domain needs for this provider, as its dashboard lists them; the nightly domain check looks for each one.

secrets.name: send_token
secrets.title: Send token
secrets.description: The Mail Agent's send token, sent as Zoho-enczapikey.

secrets.name: webhook_key
secrets.title: Webhook authentication key
secrets.description: The Mail Agent's webhook authentication key, which signs ZeptoMail's events.

health_check: Counts ZeptoMail's refusals and failed connections in recent sends; ZeptoMail cannot be asked what became of a message.
test_action: Sends one test message to the signed-in person's own verified address and reports whether ZeptoMail accepted it.
local_substitute: A fake ZeptoMail server in tests; the local stack sends through Mailpit instead.
